home.heroSubtitle: Ask any question about your Moodle data in plain language. Gemini turns it into a secure SQL query, executed read-only by MoodQ.
home.feature1Text: Every AI-generated query is checked server-side before execution: only SELECT and WITH are allowed.
home.feature2Text: Only table and column names are sent to the AI — never your students' actual data.
home.feature3Text: Privacy by design: emails, passwords, and sensitive tables stay out of the AI's reach.
home.feature4Text: A fast, precise NL2SQL engine dedicated to turning your questions into analytics queries.
